headline: NASA hopes the commercial space industry can help save Hubble
summary: Hubble telescope is slowly falling out of orbit. NASA is seeking proposals from commercial space companies. The goal is to boost Hubble's orbit and extend its lifespan.

headline: Flock keeps ignoring requests to cancel its contracts
summary: Cities are struggling to cancel contracts with Flock Safety. Plymouth, MN, voted to terminate its contract but Flock ignored the request. Surveillance cameras remained active for over a month despite the city's decision.

headline: Apple’s HomeView could add security camera features
summary: Hints found in HomeView 27.2 code suggest new security camera features. These include motion detection, live streaming, and recording options. A setup page explicitly mentions security camera mode.

headline: A fully playable version of Portal prequel F-Stop leaked
summary: A canceled Portal prequel, F-Stop, has been pieced together into a playable version. Most assets came from a massive 12-terabyte leak in August. The game's source code and map data recently completed the leak, enabling a near-complete release.

headline: Heat Director Michael Mann Hospitalized After Accidental Shooting
summary: Director Michael Mann was hospitalized with minor injuries. He accidentally shot himself in the leg. The incident occurred at a Los Angeles gun range on Halloween.

headline: Taika Waititi Blasts Critics After Negative Reviews
summary: Filmmaker Taika Waititi slammed critics following negative reviews for 'Klara and the Sun'. He called critics 'sad lost souls who couldn't achieve their dreams'. Waititi labeled critics as 'irrelevant, out of touch, obsolete'.

headline: Hoyoverse’s Cozy Sim Petit Planet Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027
summary: Hoyoverse is developing a new cozy simulation game called Petit Planet. The game is slated for release on the Nintendo Switch 2. It is expected to launch in 2027.

headline: Downey Jr. and Pascal Swap Superhero Costumes for Halloween
summary: Robert Downey Jr. and Pedro Pascal surprised fans with Halloween costumes. They swapped roles as Mister Fantastic and Doctor Doom. Their creative swap was a viral highlight of Halloween.

headline: Russian Strikes Cut Power in Ukraine as Kherson Ceasefire Ends
summary: Russian strikes have cut power to thousands in Ukraine. The attacks occurred as a rare humanitarian ceasefire in Kherson ended. Civilians had been allowed to evacuate the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky.

headline: Five Teenagers Stabbed at Halloween Party
summary: Five teenagers were stabbed at a Halloween party in Chandler's Ford. Police believe an unknown group gained entry to the private address. Investigations into the incident by Hampshire Police are ongoing.

headline: Thousands of Jobs to be Cut at Virgin Media O2
summary: Virgin Media O2 plans to cut thousands of jobs. The broadband provider has not yet finalized the exact number of roles. The cuts are expected to represent a sizeable chunk of its workforce.

headline: Nowak Family's 'Unbelievable Pain' Over Son's Handcuffed Death Footage
summary: The Nowak family described 'unbelievable pain' after seeing footage of their dying son. The footage showed him being handcuffed. The family recounted the night police informed them of his death.
